legal_units.text: Specified Business: Business of operation of ships, other than cruise ships referred to in Serial number 2.; Specified Assessee: Non- resident.; Profits And Gains Of Business Or Profession: 7.5% of (A+B), where, A = sum on account of carriage of passengers, livestock, mail or goods shipped at any port in India, whether paid or payable, in or outside India, to the assessee or any other person on his behalf (including demurrage, handling or other similar charges); B = sum on account of carriage of passengers, livestock, mail or goods shipped at any port outside India, whether received or deemed to be received in India, by the assessee or any other person on his behalf (including demurrage, handling or other similar charges).
